solutions.title: Business and institutional formalities coordinator
solutions.summary: A managed service that helps new or growing businesses identify registration requirements, assemble documents, follow appointments and retain proof of submissions, with official filings performed through authorized channels.
solutions.gate: Public guidance, independent preparation and customer-authorized assisted handoff only.

solutions.title: Tax compliance dossier and deadline manager
solutions.summary: Organize taxpayer obligations, supporting records, returns preparation, filing calendars and correspondence for DGI/DGE/CIME workflows without impersonating the tax authority or issuing official tax documents.
solutions.gate: Public guidance, independent preparation and customer-authorized assisted handoff only.

solutions.title: Fiscal transaction preparation and authorized submission gateway
solutions.summary: Prepare transaction and invoicing evidence against applicable rules and coordinate authorized filing, submission status and exceptions where the fiscal authority permits a documented integration.
solutions.gate: External protocol and signed partner approval mandatory before execution.

solutions.title: Import–export trade case coordinator
solutions.summary: Create trade cases, gather declaration documents, track freight and customs milestones, and coordinate licensed customs professionals and approved official channels.
solutions.gate: Accredited intermediary and client representation mandate required for restricted work.

solutions.title: GUCE trade-participant onboarding and process integration
solutions.summary: Assist eligible enterprises and accredited intermediaries with GUCE participation readiness and interoperable trade records, without claiming API access or replacing GUCE's official single window.
solutions.gate: GUCE authorized partnership/protocol required; no credentials reuse or scraping.

solutions.title: Import landed-cost and duty estimation service
solutions.summary: Combine goods value, freight, approved tariffs and tax assumptions into documented landed-cost estimates that are clearly separate from binding customs assessments.
solutions.gate: Non-binding computations and administrative preparation; never official assessment.

solutions.title: Exporter licensing and documentation readiness service
solutions.summary: Prepare sector-specific exporter checklists and document packs, identify responsible authorities, and track evidence for trade authorizations and inspections.
solutions.gate: Public guidance, independent preparation and customer-authorized assisted handoff only.

solutions.title: Goods origin, certification and provenance dossier operator
solutions.summary: Record source, batch, inspection and certification evidence for agricultural, forest and industrial goods and coordinate authorized validation where required.
solutions.gate: Competent authority retains certification or approval and controls integration access.

solutions.title: Product standards and homologation preparation service
solutions.summary: Help producers identify applicable quality or homologation requirements, submit supporting test and product information through approved channels, and track outstanding reviews.
solutions.gate: Competent authority retains certification or approval and controls integration access.

solutions.title: Agricultural and phytosanitary procedure coordinator
solutions.summary: Organize plant/animal product inspection, traceability and permit documents, with handoffs to competent public authorities or accredited inspection partners.
solutions.gate: Accredited sector professional and authority-approved handoff required.

solutions.title: Environmental permitting and regulatory reporting assistant
solutions.summary: Track environmental obligations, inspection calendars, supporting reports and permit applications for processing, recycling and industrial operators.
solutions.gate: Formal approval/appropriate professional accreditation where regulated.

solutions.title: Construction and property approvals coordinator
solutions.summary: Maintain project documentation and permit-readiness checklists, route requests to the competent local authorities and track decision records.
solutions.gate: The public authority or its authorized representative controls any submission.

solutions.title: Healthcare licensing and facility readiness assistant
solutions.summary: Provide documented checklists for facility and practitioner administrative requirements, renewal tracking and verified institutional correspondence without asserting licensure.
solutions.gate: Clinical licensing/authorization solely with competent authorities.

solutions.title: Transport operator permits and compliance coordinator
solutions.summary: Track fleet/operator registration records, licence renewal schedules, inspection requirements and regulator-specific documents for passenger and commercial fleets.
solutions.gate: The public authority or its authorized representative controls any submission.

solutions.title: Bank financing application packaging service
solutions.summary: With explicit customer consent, assemble verifiable business profiles, operational evidence and credit application packages for review by partner banks; financing decisions remain with licensed institutions.
solutions.gate: Bank partner agreement and informed customer consent; no credit decisions or custody.

solutions.title: Trade domiciliation and bank documentation coordinator
solutions.summary: Collect and track required trade, banking, and shipping evidence across a transaction and hand cases to authorized financial and trade professionals.
solutions.gate: Licensed banks and permitted trade stakeholders own restricted activities.

solutions.title: Merchant payment-provider onboarding coordinator
solutions.summary: Support merchants in preparing KYC, business and technical integration packs for licensed payment providers; transactions and customer funds remain with those providers.
solutions.gate: Licensed PSP/bank partnership for regulated payment processing, no fund custody by ADS.

solutions.title: Insurance document and referral aggregator
solutions.summary: Help businesses organize risk profiles, supporting documents and policy enquiries for participating insurers while reserving underwriting, claims and intermediary activity to appropriately authorized parties.
solutions.gate: Licensed insurance professionals and carriers control regulated intermediation.

solutions.title: Multi-sector regulatory requirements and renewal tracker
solutions.summary: Maintain a sourced directory of applicable obligations, official updates, filing deadlines and renewal alerts that operators can manage without direct regulator system access.
solutions.gate: Sources limited to public official regulatory information until permission is granted.

solutions.title: Multi-agency case preparation and coordination desk
solutions.summary: Let an authorized professional coordinate checklists, client mandates, document requests, staff tasks and correspondence involving several independent agencies from one business dashboard.
solutions.gate: Case coordination with lawful, explicit scope of representation and authorization.
